description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Dataset_Sequential', a subclass of 'Image_Graph_Dataset_Trivial'. It implements a simple sequential dataset where points are added with implicitly incrementing X-values. The class provides methods to add points, retrieve X-values, and determine minimum and maximum X-values. It appears to be part of a larger graph rendering library, specializing in datasets organized sequentially, typically used for bar charts or similar visualizations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Sequential
classes.description: A dataset class for sequential data points, extending a trivial dataset, providing methods to add sequentially indexed points and retrieve X-values.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Sequential
methods.description: Constructor, initializes the dataset with optional data array.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a point to the dataset with an implicit X-value based on the count.

methods.name: _getPointX
methods.description: Private method to get the X value from the provided input, casting it to integer.

methods.name: minimumX
methods.description: Returns the minimum X-value, which is fixed at 0.

methods.name: maximumX
methods.description: Returns the maximum X-value, which is the current count of points.
